name: Presa de El Gasco

position.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/724280364 (centroid of the outline of the dam; the downstream wall, way 672259124, runs at 97.9°)

rights.note: Project of Carlos Lemaur (1785) for the Canal del Guadarrama of the Banco de San Carlos; built 1787–1799 under his sons Carlos and Manuel Lemaur and left unfinished after the storm of 14 May 1799. A ruin in the Parque Regional del curso medio del río Guadarrama.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap way 724280364 — outline of the dam (waterway=dam), its centroid and orientation (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)
OpenStreetMap ways 672259124 (the downstream wall), 672259125–672259130 (the cell walls in the breach) and 202587589 (the Guadarrama through the outlet) (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)

Presa de El Gasco — Wikipedia (es): 53 m left of the planned 92 m, 154 m of wall, 72 m wide at the base and 32 m at the top, two granite walls (2.8 and 3.5 m) with transverse walls into cells of 8.5 × 10 m filled with earth and stones, upstream face at 60°, downstream face almost vertical, the collapse of 1799

PNOA orthophoto, © Instituto Geográfico Nacional de España, CC BY 4.0 — the breach, the outlet, the trees and the remains of the cells on the top

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1297922_presa_de_el_gasco.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. The ruin as it stands: the two wings of granite masonry, the downstream face almost vertical (no steps: Wikipedia says the downstream wall had neither steps nor buttresses), the upstream face battered at 60°, the top 32 m wide with low remains of the cell walls and holm oaks; the breach of 1799 in the middle (38.5 m between two cell walls), with the earth fill slumped to about 47 m, three cell walls standing out of it and the lower 19 m of the downstream wall still across it; the vaulted outlet of the river at its foot (drawn as a dark tunnel 10 m deep, not right through the dam), the two long cracks of the east wing. y = 0 is the river below the dam (644.5 m, ground_elev), the crest at 56 m. The rock of the gorge is drawn around the dam (a rock skirt following the MDT05 with the dam's own hump taken out; its rim dips 14 m into the ground). ground: keep with ground_fit false (a dam across a gorge). Uncertain: the batter of the downstream face (1:16 taken), the height of the lower wall and the level of the fill in the breach (±3 m), the size of the outlet (±1 m), the ends of the wings inside the hillsides. Note: the MDT05 (and so terrain.json) still carries the dam as a smooth hump; with ground_fit false the game does not cut it, so near the foot of the downstream face, around the outlet and in the breach the detailed terrain may show a few metres above the model.
